name: Monad

key_findings: First Retail Grade TradFi score, and first chain where no gate cap binds on either axis.

Tokenomics & Supply (34) is MON's weakest category by a wide margin -- team+investors+treasury hold ~50.6% of supply behind a single 12-month cliff, with a November 24, 2026 unlock of ~1.4x current circulating supply landing in one day.
On-Chain Health (54) reflects a 150-170x transactions-per-active-address ratio independently flagged as a farming signature.
First full-EVM chain scored to clear Deterministic Finality outright -- 300ms blocks / 600ms full finality post-MIP-12.
Execution Layer (86) is MON's strongest AI category -- fast block times and native Execution Events streaming.
First chain scored under AI Principle 16 -- sub-12-month chains evaluated on their actual record rather than penalized for a maturity window they haven't had time to accumulate.

watch_items: November 24, 2026 unlock cliff (16.6-16.8B MON, ~1.4x current float, single day) -- re-assess Tokenomics & Supply and On-Chain Health after the unlock.
Incentive wind-down -- expected 30-70%+ TVL contraction once points programs lapse; re-assess On-Chain Health when this occurs.
Automated slashing is currently logging-only -- the single largest deduction inside AI Security Posture; re-check at every future re-assessment.
